What to post:

  • Something that would need advice (eg: I am going to collage, and I had no preparation to it. What are some things I should know?)

  • Something that would need explaining on what is going on (eg: Why are people hating Ellen Pao?)

  • Something that would need a straight answer (eg: Am I allowed to take legal action for someone who doesn't pay me in an under the counter payment?)

  • Something that would tell you what to do (eg: My mom is coming home early, and there would be the smell of marajuana when she comes back. What do I do?)

  • Something that would need an answer to a homework-like question (eg: How do I integrate y=sinh(x)?)

  • Something that would require instructions to answer (eg: My computer fan isn't working, and my computer is starting to smoke, how do I fix this?)

  • Something that could use an answer a "What would happen if" question by knowledge (eg: What would happen if I snap two 9v batteries together?)

What not to post:

  • Something that would need something of someone else (eg: Does anyone have an old phone to give?)

  • Open ended questions (eg: What would be the funniest thing to leave in a shopping cart in home depot?) Those posts are for /v/askvoat

  • Help on illegal stuff (eg: How do I extract ricin from castor beans?)

  • Something a little bit of research would answer (eg: What's the most common name?)

  • Something that could use an answer a "What would happen if" question by doing it (Either dangerous or stupid eg:"What would happen if I reply to a noreply e-mail:. Or "What would happen if I smacked a random guy in the face in NY?")

If there are any problems, feel free to ask (these rules are not fixed)
